disposition_reason: Lead and cadmium were measured by AAS in the liver and kidneys of 40 broiler chickens bought in five Lahore markets; per-bird values and per-market descriptive statistics are printed. Muscle meat was not analysed.

study.design: market survey, 8 broiler chickens from each of 5 areas
study.market: markets of Sadar Cantt, Shahdra, Alkarim Park, Anarkali and Muslim Town, Lahore, Pakistan
study.method: wet digestion with HNO3/H2O2 (1:1) on a hot plate at 120 C, flame AAS at PCSIR laboratory
study.qa: standard and blank run after every five samples; no CRM or recovery reported

unresolved: Cadmium values of about 25-28 ug/g in liver and kidney are very high for broiler offal and identical value-SD pairs (e.g. 26.03±0.108) recur across many birds and both organs; recorded as printed.
The methods say organs were separated 'after slaughtering the rats', an apparent drafting error; the samples are described elsewhere as broiler chickens.
Figures 4.1-4.5 plot percentages and were not read.
Wet or dry basis is not stated.
